notes.title: Canyon Map and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/27dc8b7b3ccab391f91c9a15f0f32a1be7b5fbe8.png[/img]

[h1]Brace yourselves[/h1]
It is finally here. A brand-new map for Hard2Fly. Featuring 4 new tracks of which one is supposed to be "super very easy". One track takes you around the Canyon in a not so difficult way. And then there is two more tracks that will get your heartrate up.

[h2]There is something else[/h2]
I cannot go into details here. But let’s just say the amount of tracks to fly didn't just double with the new map. It is now 16 different leaderboards for you to claim your ranks in. If you find it - you will know.

Enjoy!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new Canyon map including 4 tracks
[*] Added a special for players to find and activate
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] On Fly-Maps: Manually set a new respawn position by holding right mouse button or right bumper
[*] Fly menu has a sub menu for map selection now
[*] Ghost Drones will be reset when changing the active track
[*] Debris is auto. cleared on track activation
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed some conditions in the Tutorial to avoid market areas from not spawning
[/list]

notes.title: Launched - now what?
notes.content:
[h1]Thoughts on the first week [/h1]
Hard2Fly launched without me having a solid idea on what to expect. I thought I was prepared for most cases and I am glad it did not turn out to be the worst case. The first week has been an emotional roller coaster ride. Some real heartwarming feedback and indices have helped a lot in dealing with generally low sales and Wishlist-conversion. It is too soon for me to draw an overall conclusion on the project as the road ahead is long enough to explore and learn from.

Bottom line: Hard2Fly has left some debris here and there (no sh**?). But it is within the prospected scenarios.

[h1]Content Update #1[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/e583bbce8248252d15d07b7093405d6725694756.png[/img]
Since a few things have not made it into the release version, I am currently working on finishing an addition map with another set of tracks as well as fixing a couple ugly bugs. Stay tuned for a brand-new map in the days ahead.

[h1]Player Experience - Submit your clip[/h1]
I would like to create a short compilation video on player experience and moments to better reflect what Hard2Fly is like to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/224f722e6561cfddba92ae5112932bd29fcedd27.gif[/img]
Maybe you like the idea and want to help me out with capturing your emotional moments (good or bad) when playing the game. I am open to any submissions in any language, especially if it truly reflects your experience.

Submit a link to your video clip on a channel of your choice:
[list]
[*] Discord: LamaRageKine#2395
[*] Twitter: @LamaRageGames
[*] Email: contact@lama-rage.ch
[/list]

Submission ends 30th of August. For your submission you'll be granted a steam key for Hard2Fly for you to give to a friend and challenge them. And yes, there is probably a little goodie for the best submissions too.

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
[h1]It is time to crash drones![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/b20664ce11ef8a4d2c8a67b8eb3e366a1a8c6d64.gif[/img]
Most players are unfamiliar with these controls and will face a challenge. Whether you manage to learn it or not, I would love to see you try. [u]Hard2Fly is not for everyone, but maybe it is just for you.[/u]

Check out the community hub for support, Q&A, feedback and hopefully more.

[h1]Let's be honest[/h1]
I am a one-man developer on his first steam release. Things are expected to go any direction (especially south, very-very south). Join me on this journey, you can still use the steam refund option to leave. I appreciate you giving it a try.

To sum up my feelings of pressing that "release" button:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/45ca1de5e97d4ba516e998818fffe6485ece3d98.png[/img]
